warnings: Pile cap F1 on one I-section pile I 0.22x0.22 (SAFE LOAD 20 t/pile); pile length not printed. main_bar.count is the two-way total 7+7 (section 6b); the cap is square 0.50 x 0.50 so depth_mm is omitted; height_mm is the 0.60 cap only (lean 0.05 and sand 0.05 kept in their own fields).
The 1.00 depth to the cap top is printed against ระดับดินเดิม, which carries no value and is never tied to ระดับดินถม ±0.00 in this set - kept on the element (ground_reference), not as a z level.
S1 prints a short-span and a long-span section with the same reinforcement - merged to one entry. Top bars over supports recorded in additional_bars; the bottom mesh is main_bar.
GS is detailed here but no plan sheet in the set uses the mark GS (S-02 has only S1 and PS) - recorded as printed, flagged.
